name: Board
description: Cards grouped into columns by status or stage, with optional dragging and adding.

classes.ayy-board__actions: Column actions at the inline end.

default.looks: Columns with headings, counts and cards.

pressed.looks: Card and Drag and drop provide the interaction feedback.

focus.looks: The control has its focus ring.

disabled.none: Disable an action or use aria-disabled on a draggable item.

selected.looks: Card uses the featured treatment and aria-current.

error.none: Show an Alert or inline error near the board.

loading.none: Show Skeleton cards in the column.

dragging.looks: Drag and drop marks the card, targets and drop edge.

sizes.density: Controls follow density and size scope.
sizes.width: Columns use --ayy-board-column-width (17rem by default); the board scrolls inline.

js: boardClass({ className? }); boardColumnClass, boardHeaderClass, boardTitleClass, boardCountClass, boardActionsClass, boardCardsClass, boardCardClass, boardEmptyClass, boardAddClass.

props.type: string — type checked by drop targets

a11y: Label the board and each column; cards are focusable.
Alt+arrow keys move cards along and across columns; Drag and drop announces moves.
do: Use a board for cards grouped into columns by status or stage.
Update the controlled card lists in onMove and provide stable IDs.
dont: Don't use a board for a simple list — use List or Table.
